subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard completion become fail-closed on a new durable review lifecycle with a `ready_to_merge` status, or should the review gate be redesigned around existing statuses/contracts first?
rationale: This PR changes stored card state and existing completion behavior, so maintainers must accept the product and upgrade semantics separately from fixing the mechanical bugs.

options.title: Repair and keep the review lifecycle
options.body: Accept the direction but require the completion gate, response contract, metadata declarations, UI/status consumers, tests, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Avoid a new durable status
options.body: Redesign the flow around existing `review` and `done` states if maintainers do not want `ready_to_merge` persisted as card state.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the branch open but do not merge until a maintainer sponsors the fail-closed lifecycle and required upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep the review lifecycle
recommendation.body: Accept the direction but require the completion gate, response contract, metadata declarations, UI/status consumers, tests, and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal for Workboard tools, lifecycle, manifest, and stored-status surfaces.
